name: orphan-disease-opportunity-mcp
description: Orphan disease startup blueprints, JAK2+ & autoimmune MF biology, non-dilutive grants, and validation MCP.
long_description: Zero-dependency Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for high-tractability orphan disease translational and venture blueprints (Flagships: Clonal JAK2 V617F+ Myelofibrosis and Autoimmune Myelofibrosis + Iron/Hepcidin Axis), FDA Orphan Drug economics, non-dilutive grants, and ethical patient-community validation.

tools.name: match_founder_opportunities
tools.description: Filter orphan disease startup and translational blueprints by founder background, capital tier, and wet-lab requirement.

tools.name: get_disease_case_study
tools.description: Retrieve verified biology, trial readouts, open GEO/PDB datasets, and FDA orphan economics for a disease case study.

tools.name: find_non_dilutive_grants
tools.description: List non-dilutive grants, SBIR/STTR mechanisms, and venture philanthropy tracks for orphan disease translation.

tools.name: get_validation_communities
tools.description: Retrieve patient registries, institutional research networks, and anti-spam ethical validation guidelines.

tools.name: submit_atlas_feedback
tools.description: Submit opt-in non-PII feedback, missing founder wedges, or ClinicalTrials.gov citation errata.
